incident.message: ErrImagePull: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist": failed to resolve reference "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist": public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist: not found

classification.rationale: The container image `python:0.0.0-does-not-exist` cannot be pulled from the registry, preventing the pod from starting.

diagnosis.root_cause: The Deployment badimage-demo was rolled to revision 2 with a non-existent container image tag (python:0.0.0-does-not-exist). The ECR registry returns NotFound / manifest unknown for this tag, so Kubernetes cannot pull the image and the new pod is stuck in ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff. The previous revision (1) used python:3.12-slim which was ready and is still available in ReplicaSet badimage-demo-5c588d65d7.

evidence.value: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = failed to pull and unpack image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist": failed to resolve reference "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist": public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist: not found
Failed to pull image "public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:0.0.0-does-not-exist": rpc error: code = NotFound ...

proposal.rationale: Revision 1 used python:3.12-slim and was ready (1/1). Rolling the image back to that tag will immediately unblock the Deployment. Once the correct new tag is built and pushed to the registry, a fresh rollout can be attempted.
proposal.risk: Rolls back to the previously running image (revision 1). Any code changes introduced in revision 2 will not be served until the correct image tag is pushed and the Deployment is updated again. No data loss is expected.
proposal.delivery: Apply as a pull request against /gitops after a human approves it. The agent does not change the cluster.

similar_incidents.title: PM-2026-072: search-indexer rollout stuck on a tag that was never pushed
similar_incidents.fix: Rolled the container image back to the image of the last ReplicaSet revision that was Ready (indexer:2.13.2, revision 41) via a GitOps pull request, then rebuilt and pushed the missing tag before releasing again.
similar_incidents.excerpt: The registry returned `manifest unknown` for the new tag. Kubernetes behaved as designed: `maxUnavailable: 0` kept the old pod running. ## Evidence - Pod events: `Failed to pull image "...indexer:2.14.0": not found`, then `Back-off pulling image`. - Container state: `waiting.reason: ImagePullBackOff`. - ReplicaSet history: revision 41 image `indexer:2.13.2`, ready 1/1; revision 42 image `indexer:2

similar_incidents.title: PM-2026-079: notification-gateway crash loop after a ConfigMap key rename
similar_incidents.fix: Restored the required key SMTP_HOST in the ConfigMap the Deployment loads with envFrom (keeping the new key too) and restarted the Deployment. Clue: exit code 1 with a config error in the previous container log, normal memory and CPU.
similar_incidents.excerpt: The rename was valid YAML and passed review, but nothing checked that the application still found the keys it requires. A second Deployment that used `valueFrom.configMapKeyRef` on the old key failed earlier and louder, with `CreateContainerConfigError: couldn't find key SMTP_HOST in ConfigMap notify/gateway-config`. ## Evidence - Previous container log: `FATAL config: SMTP_HOST is required` then
